queries: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb, AVG(CAST(l.UN AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.SEX) <> '' GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(avg_un_tbil_ratio) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_alb, avg_un_tbil_ratio, avg_alb - (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM sex_averages) AS alb_above_mean FROM sex_averages WHERE avg_alb > (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM sex_averages);

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, TRIM(p.SEX) AS sex, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb, AVG(CAST(l.UN AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_un_t_bil_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(p.SEX), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.ID, TRIM(p.SEX)), sex_averages AS (SELECT sex, AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(avg_un_t_bil_ratio) AS avg_un_t_bil_ratio FROM patient_averages GROUP BY sex), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) AS mean_avg_alb FROM sex_averages) SELECT s.sex, s.avg_alb, s.avg_un_t_bil_ratio, s.avg_alb - o.mean_avg_alb AS alb_above_mean FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o WHERE s.avg_alb > o.mean_avg_alb;

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb, AVG(l.UN * 1.0 / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.SEX) <> '' GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(avg_un_tbil_ratio) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) AS mean_sex_alb FROM sex_averages) SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_alb, s.avg_un_tbil_ratio, s.avg_alb - o.mean_sex_alb AS alb_above_mean FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_alb > o.mean_sex_alb;
